description: Postman Test Examples for Food Addons and Orders API

headers.note: Always include Content-Type: application/json header for POST/PUT requests

body.name: Extra Egg
body.description: Add an extra egg to your meal

get_all_addons.description: Get all addons for a restaurant

get_single_addon.description: Get a single addon by ID

delete_addon.description: Delete an addon (will fail if assigned to foods)

add_addon_to_food.description: Add an addon to a food item. maxQuantity is for paid addons only.

add_free_addon_to_food.description: Add a free addon to a food (maxQuantity should be null for free addons)

get_food_addons.description: Get all addons for a specific food

remove_addon_from_food.description: Remove an addon from a food

get_food_with_addons.description: Get a single food with its addons included

get_all_foods_with_addons.description: Get all foods with addons included

create_order_simple.description: Create a simple order with one food item and one addon

create_order_complex.description: Create a complex order with multiple food items and addons

create_order_with_free_addon.description: Create an order with a free addon (quantity must be 1 for free addons)

get_all_orders.description: Get all orders with optional filters

get_single_order.description: Get a single order with full details including addons

update_order_status.description: Update order status. Valid statuses: PENDING, CONFIRMED, PREPARING, READY, DELIVERED, CANCELLED

cancel_order.description: Cancel an order (cannot cancel DELIVERED or already CANCELLED orders)

get_user_orders.description: Get all orders for a specific user

notes.base_url: Update the base URL (http://localhost:3000) to match your server
notes.ids: Replace all ID values (1, 2, etc.) with actual IDs from your database

important_headers.content_type: Always set Content-Type: application/json header for POST and PUT requests
important_headers.postman_setup: In Postman: Select 'Body' tab → Choose 'raw' → Select 'JSON' from dropdown (this automatically sets the header)

common_errors.req_body_undefined: If you get 'req.body is undefined' error, make sure Content-Type header is set to application/json
common_errors.validation_errors: Check that all required fields are provided and IDs are valid numbers
common_errors.restaurant_mismatch: Addon and food must belong to the same restaurant

addon_notes.free_addons: Free addons have price = 0. Quantity is always 1 when ordering.
addon_notes.paid_addons: Paid addons have price > 0. Quantity can be 1 to maxQuantity (if set).
addon_notes.maxQuantity: maxQuantity in FoodAddon is optional. If not set, unlimited quantity is allowed for paid addons.

order_notes.addon_quantity: For free addons, quantity must be exactly 1. For paid addons, quantity can be 1 to maxQuantity.
order_notes.addon_pricing: Addon prices are snapshotted at order creation time in OrderItemAddon.price
order_notes.total_calculation: Total = (food price × quantity) + (addon price × addon quantity × food quantity) + delivery fee

testing_flow.step_1: 1. Create addons (free and paid) using POST /addons
testing_flow.step_2: 2. Create food items (if needed) using existing food endpoints
testing_flow.step_3: 3. Assign addons to foods using POST /foods/{foodId}/addons
testing_flow.step_4: 4. Verify food addons using GET /foods/{foodId} or GET /foods/{foodId}/addons
testing_flow.step_5: 5. Create orders with food items and selected addons using POST /orders
testing_flow.step_6: 6. Manage orders (view, update status, cancel) using order endpoints
